summary: Frontend-only verification of School Dashboard 'Add User' Create-New vs Add-Existing mode toggle. Logged in via /school-login (springfield/school123), opened Add User modal, verified toggles, tested Add Existing error path (ghost_user_xyz → 'No account found' error toast, backend returned 404 as expected), tested Add Existing happy path (identifier 'maptest_teacher' → success toast + modal closed + 'Map Test Teacher / maptest_teacher@test.com' appeared in Teachers list, teacher count 0→1), and tested Create New path with a unique email (Test New Teacher / testnew_XXXXX@test.com → 'Teacher created successfully' toast, Teachers count 1→2). All three review scenarios pass.

issues: Radix DialogContent missing Description/aria-describedby (a11y warning in console)

critical_code_review_comments: SchoolDashboard.jsx is ~1228 lines — consider splitting Add User modal into a separate component for maintainability.
Add DialogDescription (or aria-describedby) to the Add User Dialog to remove Radix a11y warnings.
test_credentials: school: springfield/school123; existing teacher: maptest_teacher / maptest_teacher@test.com
seed_data_creation: Linked existing teacher maptest_teacher to Springfield Elementary school, and created a brand-new teacher Test New Teacher (testnew_50283@test.com) during Create New test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Because the Add Existing test now maps 'maptest_teacher' to the Springfield school, re-running this test again will fail on the happy path with 'user already belongs to a school'. Main agent should unlink the teacher (unset school_id) before rerunning, or use a new unmapped test account.
